name: Froxel Grid Construction
definition: A real-time clustered lighting and volumetrics system for Unreal Engine 5 that partitions the view frustum into a 3D grid of voxels (froxels) to efficiently assign lights to spatial regions.
summary: Froxel Grid Construction partitions the 3D view frustum into a regular 3D grid of voxels to spatially organize lights for efficient volumetric light scattering, differing from standard clustered lighting by targeting participating media.
